note: The reachable public/default request surface for framework PRODUCTS other than Vue runtime-render output. One row per SEMANTIC case; transport spellings that converge on the same typed host request are listed as routeAliases of that one case, never as separate cases. `hostEntryPoint` rows are proven live by the tests in framework_product_surface_tests.rs (calling them is the existence proof the compiler enforces); `routeAliases` are read-verified citations by default; the ones the feature-gated transport suite DRIVES are the NAPI and WASM host methods listed in NAPI_EXECUTED / WASM_EXECUTED (transport_route_equivalence_tests.rs) plus the NAPI free function `processStyle`, and the bundler `transform` hook. The bundler style / load / recompile / CSS-scoping lanes and the bundler runtime-render batch lane remain read-verified citations, not driven.
corpusProperties: Every committed Svelte golden is generated with `sourceMap: true` (packages/framework-conformance-harness/bin/generate-goldens.mjs:196), so the maps-OFF axis is not an official cell at all — it is a property of the committed corpus, not a gap in this inventory. The maps-off axis IS driven, against the host's own answer rather than an official golden, by the_source_map_axis_reaches_the_products_it_currently_reaches, a_success_publishes_no_unrequested_source_map, the_batch_source_map_axis_publishes_only_what_was_requested and the transport probes.
